verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming and remote-control app. Issuing scoped credentials for programmatic access is a fair question for this kind of product, but the evidence shows no API or agent credential mechanism. Device pairing and device removal are adjacent controls for human devices, not least-privilege API credentials, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
